coverage_bootstrap.shared_draws: same document draws for every profile and paired difference
coverage_bootstrap.undefined_draws: draws without denominator are dropped and counted, never set to zero

stages.detection: proposals of detect(), one call per document and profile
stages.final_check: alerts on the pseudonymized text; an alert masks nothing
stages.pseudonymization: automatic substitution of every proposal, no human review

notes: Stages: detection lists proposals; pseudonymization substitutes every proposal automatically; final check reports alerts on the pseudonymized text.
Alerts do not mask anything: leakage after the final check equals leakage after pseudonymization. No stage simulates a reviewer who knows the annotations.
Coverage counts characters replaced by any substitution, whatever the predicted type. Historical metrics are unchanged and never credit a wrong label.
Full coverage means every character of a reference is masked; one visible character prevents it. Over-masking counts masked characters outside every annotation.
The eleven historical types form the comparison scope; CUSTOM and LOCATION are separate.
n/a means not applicable (no denominator); it is not a guarantee of zero leakage.

selected_threshold.criterion: fixed in the robustness plan before measurement
